# Third-party frontend assets

- `qrcode-generator.js`: QR Code Generator for JavaScript, copyright Kazuhiko Arase, MIT License.
- `../icons/tabler/*.svg`: selected Tabler Icons, copyright Paweł Kuna, MIT License. The full license is stored at `../icons/tabler/LICENSE`.

- `pyodide/`: Pyodide 314.0.6 (MPL-2.0), CPython 3.14.2, and Emscripten 5.0.3 browser runtime. Sources, full license files, version information and checksums are in [pyodide/README.md](pyodide/README.md).

These dependencies are vendored so the classroom interface and browser Python remain usable without internet access.
